clauses.name: aggregate conversion win rate improves by at least 15 percentage points
conversion wins improve for every training seed
cycling draw incidence falls by at least 25 percent relative
standard win rate drop is at most 5 percentage points
no seed loses more than 15 percentage points on standard
conversion loss rate rises by at most 5 percentage points
conversion effect appears in both candidate seats

interpretation.replicate_scope: The three models remain independent optimizer and policy-initialization replicates under paired treatments, but they are not independent map-exposure replicates because their incrementing episode-seed ranges overlap heavily.
interpretation.selector_bias_check: The profiled-seeded-v1 selector was also checked over 10,000 consecutive seeds and was close to the declared distribution; the panel skew is local to the selected episode-seed ranges, not evidence of a globally biased mixer.
interpretation.treatment_scope: The realized mixed treatment is 42.55 percent standard and 57.45 percent conversion. Far profiles received 36.36 percent of episodes and near profiles 21.09 percent, rather than the nominal 30/30 split. Locked results must be reported against realized exposure and must not be used to retune weights.
